investment_theses.thesis: Bitcoin outperforms S&P 500 from now through November 2026 if Fed holds rates steady and Trump coalition fragmentation drives safe-haven rotation.
supporting_signals: CoinDesk $68M bet targeting $90K Bitcoin breakout post-midterm
CNBC: Fed likely to hold in October; stable rates reduce BTC opportunity cost vs. equities
CNBC: Trump coalition 'seriously weakened' per new survey; political uncertainty can spur flight to non-correlated assets
investment_theses.counter_view: If Fed cuts rates aggressively to support equity market or recession looms, stocks rally harder than BTC; AI momentum could re-accelerate into 2027, favoring tech.
investment_theses.expression: Long BTC perps or BTC/SPY ratio; buy Bitcoin spot, sell SPX calls 6-month duration; or BTC 2x long ETF vs. SPY short-term call ratio spread.

investment_theses.thesis: Non-AI mega-cap tech (Microsoft, Apple) underperforms S&P 500 ex-AI through June 2026 as capital efficiency pressures and supply-chain disruption (iPhone Duo foldable issues) weigh on margins.
supporting_signals: CNBC: S&P 500 ex-AI beating traditional index; AI trade fraying
CNBC: Microsoft offering 60K voluntary buyouts—capex/headcount rebalancing underway
CNBC: Apple iPhone Duo foldable screen failures; warranty replacement costs could pressure services margin
investment_theses.counter_view: Microsoft AI infrastructure capex pays off faster than expected (Copilot/Mephisto adoption); Apple services moat remains defensive; both companies execute buybacks to offset dilution.
investment_theses.expression: Underweight MSFT + AAPL vs. Russell 2000 or equal-weight sector rotators (XLY, XLE, XLF); short 3-month MSFT/AAPL correlation basket; or buy SPLG (S&P 500 equal-weight) vs. short SPX.

investment_theses.thesis: Stablecoin-adjacent fintech tokens and community-bank enablers outperform broad crypto if OCC stablecoin guidance and NBA/Kalshi deal catalyze Q2–Q3 2026 institutional adoption wave.
supporting_signals: OCC calls on community banks to enter stablecoin payments market
NBA officially names Kalshi + Polymarket as CFTC-approved preferred exchanges; S&P Dow Jones Indices partnership
CoinDesk: OCC pro-stablecoin guidance; South Korea crypto tax pushed to 2029 removes regulatory overhang
investment_theses.counter_view: Regulatory crackdown on stablecoins if SEC/CFTC flip hostile; Fed creates competing CBDC, marginalizing private stablecoins; community banks adopt hesitantly due to compliance costs.
investment_theses.expression: Long Circle (USDC yield on Aave/Lido), Uniswap governance token, or trade stablecoin spread (USDC vs. USDT). Avoid naked token bets; focus on USDC ecosystem dApps or stablecoin yield protocols.

investment_theses.thesis: Anthropic IPO underperforms initial valuation euphoria if S-1 reveals capex burn, limited revenue path, or if AI 'catastrophic risk' disclosure scares institutional allocators into June 2026.
supporting_signals: BBC: Anthropic warns of 'catastrophic risk' ahead of blockbuster IPO—legal liability tail-risk embedded in prospectus
Hacker News S-1 discussion (1175 score) suggests retail euphoria may not translate to institutional demand
CNBC: AI trade fraying; Microsoft and others cutting capex—demand for Anthropic inference/LLMs may soften
investment_theses.counter_view: Anthropic's Constitutional AI and safety brand attracts ESG/institutions; if OpenAI stumbles on safety, Anthropic premium justified. IPO pops 50%+ on first-day FOMO.
investment_theses.expression: Fade Anthropic IPO opening; short stock 3–6 months post-launch or buy out-of-money puts. Alternatively, hedge with long OpenAI (if public) or long NVDA vs. short Anthropic concept (if unfeasible).

investment_theses.thesis: DXY (US dollar index) strengthens through Q3 2026 if Fed holds rates steady and Trump coalition breakdown triggers emerging-market capital flight, despite Bitcoin narrative.
supporting_signals: CNBC: Fed expected to hold rates steady; higher real rates support USD
CNBC: Trump coalition 'seriously weakened'; geopolitical uncertainty (Brazil/Serbia elections, Venezuela, Algeria troop deployment) favors USD safe-haven
CoinDesk: Bitcoin $90K bet assumes stable/lower rates; if DXY rallies, BTC may stall
investment_theses.counter_view: US fiscal deficit widens; USD weakness as foreign central banks ease; oil rally (mentioned as 'retreating' in CoinDesk) reverses, support equities/commodities over USD.
investment_theses.expression: Long DXY ETF (UUP) or buy USD/JPY, USD/CNY calls; short emerging-market currency pairs (BRL, MXN, ZAR). Hedge with long gold if geopolitical tail-risk priced.
